commentary.bulkers: Centrofin Management have committed their Capesize "Smyrna" 176/2008 Namura & Sasebo, Japan (SS 01/2028, DD 03/2026) at USD 25,25 mill. Note that the two-years-older "Irene II" 180/2006 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 04/2026) was committed a week ago at USD 21 mill. The Post Panamax "Royal Award" 88/2007 Imabari, Japan (SS/DD 02/2027) of Pacific Rim Shipping was committed to Chinese interests at USD 11,5 mill, while the one-year-younger sister vessel "JP Caretta" 88/2008 Imabari, Japan (SS 12/2028, DD 09/2026, Scrubber fitted) was committed a couple of weeks ago at USD 13,6 mill. Ango International Shipping committed their Kamsarmax "Anglo Red" & "Anglo Barinthus" 81/2013 Sainty, China (SS 05/2028, DD 04/2026 & SS/DD 01/2028, Scrubber fitted) at USD 17,1 mill each. Remind you that the sister vessel "Theresa Hainan" 81/2013 Sainty, China (SS/DD 05/2028) was sold back in December at USD 16,3 mill. Furthermore, Onyx Ventures have committed the "Gastone" 81/2012 Sungdong, Korea (SS/DD 12/2027) at USD 17,5 mill, the same level achieved by the "Athina Carras" 82/2012 Daewoo, Korea (SS/DD 02/2027) one week earlier. On the Supramax sector, the "Lima Trader" 56/2012 Qingshan, China (SS/DD 04/2027) was committed at low USD 13 mill. Note that a month ago, the one-year-older "Pisti" 56/2011 Cosco, China (SS/DD 04/2026) was sold at USD 12,8 mill. Moreover, the "Lianson Dynamic" 53/2006 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 07/2026) was committed at USD 8,6 mill. For comparison, the sister vessel "Spar Canis" 53/2006 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 03/2026) was sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 9 mill. Cetus Maritime committed the Handysize "Asia Spirit" 35/2012 Nanjing, China (SS/DD 04/2027) at mid USD 11 mill, while the "Sigma Venture" 34/2012 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 06/2027) of Sigma Shipping was committed at USD 11,75 mill. Remind you that in December, the "Ioanna D" 34/2012 Nanjing, China (SS/DD 06/2027) was sold at USD 10,5 mill.
commentary.tankers: Clients of Sinokor have acquired the VLCCs "Ilma" & "Ingrid" 314/2012 Hyundai, Korea (SS/DD 05/2027 & SS/DD 01/2027, Scrubber fitted) from CMB.Tech at USD 89 mill each, as well as AET's "Eagle Varna" 300/2013 Daewoo, Korea (SS 03/2028, DD 03/2026) at USD 86,5 mill. The MRs "Elandra Fjord" & "Elandra Baltic" 51/2011 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 06/2030, DD 06/2028 & SS 11/2030, DD 10/2028, Ice Class 1B) were committed to Greek interests at USD 24,5 mill each. For reference, the two- years-younger "Doric Pioneer" 51/2013 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 01/2028, DD 01/2026) was sold about a month ago at USD 29,5 mill.

freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds ranged at the usd 14,000/16,000 pd. Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported fixed in the usd 12,000/15,000 pd range. Indonesian and Australian trips into India were reported at the level of usd 12,000/14,000 pd. South East Asian trips via East Coast South America into China were fixed around usd 17,000/19,000 pd. Indian trips via East Coast South America into China were fixed around usd 16,000/19,000 pd. Mediterranean trips via US Gulf into Continent were reported at the level of usd 15,000/17,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into China were fixed around usd 16,000/18,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 600K/800K. East Coast South American trips into Continent-Mediterranean range were reported at the level of usd 23,000/26,000 pd. On the period front, a Kamsarmax was reported fixed in the usd 18,500 pd for 5/8 months employment basis delivery North China.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported fixed in the usd 11,000/14,000 pd range. Indonesian trips into India were reported at the level of usd 10,000/12,000 pd. West Coast Indian into East Coast India were fixed around usd 13,000/16,000 pd. Trips from Red Sea into China were reported at the level of usd 10,000/12,000 pd. South African trips into China were fixed around usd 14,000/16,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 140K/160K. East Coast South American trips into Continent-Mediterranean range were reported at the level of usd 24,000/26,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into China were fixed around usd 13,000/15,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 300K/500K. East Coast South American trips into Arabian Gulf were reported at the level of usd 16,000/17,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 600K/700K. On the period front, a Supramax was reported fixed in the usd 14,500 pd for 5/7 months employment basis delivery Mediterranean.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: Trips from North China into South China were reported at the level of usd 7,000/9,000 pd. US Gulf trips into West Africa were fixed around usd 18,000/20,000 pd. On the period front, a small Handysize was reported fixed in the usd 16,750 pd for 3/5 months employment basis delivery US Gulf with redelivery Atlantic. Also, a small Handysize was fixed on a period at the usd 9,000 pd basis delivery China for 1 year employment.
